# gc_api fixtures

`openapi.json` is the Gas City supervisor's own description of its API, served at
`GET /openapi.json` by gc 1.5.1 (build `4f698fe2a7eefae49e545c5e38189f1b63fb9b39`), unmodified.
Gas City is [gastownhall/gascity](https://github.com/gastownhall/gascity), MIT. `spec_test.dart`
holds the client and the other fixtures to it; when gc moves, refresh it from one supervisor and
update the version above.

The other files are responses shaped like that gc's, for a made-up city `demo`.
